prerequisites: Basic knowledge in statistics and probability theory
Successful participation in the practical course related to the lecture

learning_outcomes.text: Overview of essential concepts, methods and tools of QM
Knowledge of quality management systems, structures and links of standards
Independent application of selected QM tools
Application of quality control charts, statistical evaluations and BoxPlots
Classification of quality improvement projects within the DMAIC structure

syllabus_topics: Selected tools and methods of Quality Management
Creation and application of quality control charts
Goals and methods of statistical experimental methodology
Problem solving in the operational environment
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for passing the written exam. The importance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
